shortDescription: Launch from the carrier and stop enemy scouts before they reveal your fleet.
description:
Take the cockpit in Mission 01 of Joker's Run, an arcade flight combat game for Samsung Smart TV. Launch from a carrier, learn your maneuvers, intercept enemy recon aircraft, fight their escorts, chase a scout through coastal cliffs, and challenge an enemy ace before the final transmission.

Play with your Samsung Smart Remote using assisted steering, or connect a standard gamepad for direct flight controls. Pause to change flight commands, adjust sound and invert pitch, or restart from a checkpoint. Recorded squadron radio and captions guide the mission. Your best score and settings stay on your TV.

The complete Mission 01 is included and works offline. Breakout is a next-mission teaser and is not a second playable mission. No accounts, ads, in-app purchases, subscriptions, or analytics.
